title: 词典 C
html:
词典 C

概述

本页收录以字母 C 开头的实用词汇，按职场与商务、日常与社交、技术相关等场景分组。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，并附易混淆词辨析和高频短语，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

职场与商务

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
collaborate v. 协作 collaborate with/on We collaborate closely with the design team.
consensus n. 共识 reach a consensus The team reached a consensus on the release date.
criteria n. 标准（复数） evaluation criteria Candidates are assessed based on clear criteria.
compensation n. 薪酬、补偿 compensation package The compensation package includes stock options.
compliance n. 合规 regulatory compliance All products must meet compliance standards.
confidential adj. 机密的 confidential information This document contains confidential business data.
consolidate v. 整合、巩固 consolidate resources We consolidated three services into one platform.
contractor n. 承包商、外包人员 hire a contractor We brought in a contractor to help with the migration.
capacity n. 能力、容量 at full capacity The data center is running at full capacity.
clarify v. 澄清 clarify a point/requirement Could you clarify the acceptance criteria for this story?
conversion n. 转化、转换 conversion rate Optimizing the landing page improved conversion by 15%.
capitalize v. 利用、大写 capitalize on an opportunity We should capitalize on the holiday season for promotions.
coordinate v. 协调 coordinate efforts/teams The PM coordinates efforts between design and engineering.

日常与社交

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
commute n./v. 通勤 daily commute My commute takes about 40 minutes by subway.
convenient adj. 方便的 convenient location/time The office is in a very convenient location.
casual adj. 休闲的、随意的 casual wear, casual chat Friday is casual dress day at our company.
considerate adj. 体贴的 considerate of others She is always considerate of her colleagues' feelings.
compliment n./v. 赞美 pay a compliment He complimented her on the excellent presentation.
cuisine n. 菜系 local/Chinese cuisine Shanghai cuisine is famous for its sweetness.
ceremony n. 仪式 opening ceremony The award ceremony will be held next Friday.
companion n. 同伴 travel companion A good companion makes a long journey more enjoyable.
circumstance n. 情况、环境 under the circumstances Under the circumstances, postponing the trip was the right call.
courtesy n. 礼貌 common courtesy Saying thank you is just common courtesy.
cozy adj. 舒适温馨的 cozy café/apartment We found a cozy café to work from on rainy afternoons.

技术相关

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
cache n./v. 缓存 clear the cache, cache hit Clearing the browser cache resolved the display issue.
commit n./v. 提交 git commit, commit changes Please squash your commits before merging.
component n. 组件 UI component, reusable component We built a shared component library for the design system.
configure v. 配置 configure settings You need to configure the environment variables first.
container n. 容器 Docker container Each microservice runs in its own container.
concurrent adj. 并发的 concurrent requests The server can handle 10,000 concurrent connections.
compile v. 编译 compile code/errors The code failed to compile due to a syntax error.
credential n. 凭证 user credentials, API credentials Never hardcode credentials in your source code.
cluster n. 集群 Kubernetes cluster We deployed the service across a three-node cluster.
callback n. 回调 callback function The API uses a callback URL to notify payment results.
cron n. 定时任务 cron job, cron expression A cron job runs the data cleanup script every midnight.
CDN n. 内容分发网络 CDN cache, CDN provider Static assets are served through a CDN for faster loading.

易混淆词辨析

词组 区别说明
compliment vs. complement compliment「赞美」，complement「补充」。She gave him a compliment. / Red wine complements steak well.
continual vs. continuous continual「反复发生的」，continuous「不间断的」。Continual interruptions. / Continuous data stream.
comprise vs. compose comprise「包含」，compose「组成」。The team comprises five members. / Five members compose the team.
convince vs. persuade convince「使信服（思想上）」，persuade「说服（行动上）」。I'm convinced it works. / She persuaded me to try.
council vs. counsel council「委员会」，counsel「建议、律师」。City council meeting. / Legal counsel.

高频短语

短语 含义 例句
carry out 执行、实施 We carried out the migration over the weekend.
come up with 想出 She came up with a brilliant workaround.
catch up 赶上、叙旧 Let's catch up over coffee sometime.
cut corners 偷工减料 We can't cut corners on security testing.
cross-functional 跨职能的 This is a cross-functional initiative involving design and engineering.
circle back 稍后再讨论 Let's circle back on this topic after lunch.
close the loop 完成闭环 Make sure to close the loop with the client after resolving the issue.
crunch time 紧要关头 It's crunch time — the release is in two days.
count on 依靠 You can count on the QA team to catch edge cases.
come across 偶然发现 I came across a useful library for date formatting.
call off 取消 The meeting was called off due to a scheduling conflict.
chalk up to 归因于 We can chalk up the improvement to better caching.

补充词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配
cascade v./n. 级联 cascade delete/failure
checkpoint n. 检查点 save a checkpoint
chunk n. 块 data chunk/code chunk
constraint n. 约束 database constraint
cursor n. 光标 database cursor
cohort n. 群组 user cohort analysis
